title: A declared name is one edit away from `socks-proxy-agent`
description: package.json declares a declared dependency name in package.json within one edit of `socks-proxy-agent`. The dependency graph an installer resolves comes from these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package pulls foreign code into the build. The name this rule expects is `socks-proxy-agent`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `socks-proxy-agent`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `socks-proxy-agent` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `socks-proxy-agent` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
